verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a first-party docs page titled "Perform Access Review for a Critical System", plus an "Monitor Access Checks" page and integration docs showing it maps which users have access in connected systems. The access-review capability is therefore the product's own, but the evidence is only page titles and integration snippets. Nothing describes the review workflow itself. missing for 10: evidence that reviews recur on a periodic schedule rather than as one-off actions, coverage across all connected apps rather than single critical systems, in-app reviewer sign-off, the completed review artifact landing in an evidence library, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, periodic user access reviews run across connected apps in the platform — reviewers sign off in-app and the artifact lands in the evidence library

citations.quote: Perform Access Review for a Critical System
It helps Sprinto to map and check if the user with access offboards the organization.
